summary: onsemi filed an 8-K disclosing an Amended and Restated Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated October 1, 2026, to acquire Synaptics via merger subsidiary Sonic Acquisition Corp. The revision followed an unsolicited third-party Acquisition Proposal and raises consideration to $123.00 per share in cash, abandoning the prior Section 368 reorganization structure. Both boards unanimously approved and recommend the revised deal; onsemi will withdraw its Form S-4 registration statement. Equity awards receive specified treatment. Watch for a competing superior proposal, appraisal-rights dissent, financing or regulatory conditions, and any revised premium relative to the original June 25, 2026 terms.
